sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Try pressing UP many times to see if player wraps vertically
# Player at rows 17-19, need to reach rows 59-60
# If player wraps at row 0, pressing UP 18+ times might wrap to bottom

for i in range(30):
    result = action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    orange = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O']
    if orange:
        n = orange[0]
        rows = sorted([b[0] for b in n['boundary']])
        cols = sorted([b[1] for b in n['boundary']])
        if (i+1) % 10 == 0:
            print(f"After {i+1} UP: Player rows {rows[0]}-{rows[-1]}, cols {cols[0]}-{cols[-1]}")
        # Check if player wrapped (rows near bottom)
        if rows[0] >= 55:
            print(f"Player wrapped! rows {rows[0]}-{rows[-1]}, cols {cols[0]}-{cols[-1]}")
            break

# Check target
targets = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 3]
if targets:
    n = targets[0]
    rows = sorted([b[0] for b in n['boundary']])
    cols = sorted([b[1] for b in n['boundary']])
    print(f"Target rows {rows[0]}-{rows[-1]}, cols {cols[0]}-{cols[-1]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
